title: Kagamine Len — Always The Best Partners〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Between Worlds
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You two seem to be enjoying yourselves.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hi, Len!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We were just seeing how everyone in the band SEKAI was doing.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: They were all having fun playing badminton using the equipment they borrowed from Ichika and the others!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, badminton?!
That does sound like fun!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
So, Len, what were you doing just now?
Luka told us that you'd gone somewhere...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I was also checking to see how the other versions of us were doing in their SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I started with idol me.
Then, I went over to see timid me.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Really?!
How were they?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Both SEKAI seemed pretty peaceful and relaxed.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Mhm... No...
Right foot first... Then your left...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Zzz... Zzz...
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Nice work today, Rin.
I know you're all tuckered out after staying behind to keep practicing that dance.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, keep resting for as long as you like.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Also, I'll get you a blanket.
I wouldn't want you to catch a cold or anything.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Just give me one second, Rin.
se_walk_men_002_2

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Idol Len seems like such a nice person.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: He is! I know he's me, but I'm kinda starting to admire him because he's so cool and suave.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I know what you mean.
My idol counterpart makes me feel the same way.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hey, don't forget that I'm here, you guys.
Tell us more about that other SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, sure. So...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, why don't we run an experiment to see if talking about someone behind their back actually makes them sneeze?
bgm_area00005

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh...? Umm...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No thanks...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, you're no fun...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Don't either of you want to talk about MEIKO or KAITO? You may even get to see them sneeze.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Do you just want to see them sneeze, Luka...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, I'm deeply invested.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I have a feeling that MEIKO's sneezes are cute and dainty, while KAITO's are...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Sorry, Luka, but we've already made plans to meet Ena by the lake...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Plans?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, she's going to give us an art lesson...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: If you're bored enough to come up with silly experiments, then why don't you come with us...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. You saw right through me.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: In that case, I think I will join you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, Luka ended up going with them?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I know she was just trying to pass the time, but they all seem very close.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Still, Len, you were right.
Every SEKAI seems very peaceful today.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Because they're in such a peaceful state, we kinda don't need to keep an eye on them right now...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But I can't seem to stop myself from wondering what's happening.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I really enjoy seeing them having fun together. It always puts a smile on my face, y'know?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Sounds to me like you care quite a bit about how the you of those other SEKAI are doing.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: They are always doing their best for the owners of the feelings.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, I want them to take this opportunity to have as much fun as they can!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Me too!
